'''Hutchinson''': {{legend0|#ffb2b2|40–50%}} {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Mike Huckabee]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Mike Beebe]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsAR}} The '''2006 Arkansas gubernatorial election''' took place on Tuesday, November 7, 2006. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] governor [[Mike Huckabee]] was barred from seeking candidacy due to term limits set by the State Constitution in 1998, stating that the governor may only serve two terms in their lifetime. [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] State Attorney General [[Mike Beebe]] defeated [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] former U.S. representative [[Asa Hutchinson]] by a wide margin. This was the first open seat election since 1978.
